create_sweep: create a hyperparameter sweep from a list of values for a single parameter name
build_cartesian_product_sweep: build a cartesian product sweep from multiple individual parameter sweeps
zip_sweeps: zip multiple parameter sweeps together pairing values by index position
test_sweep_function: test the sweep function with various value types including ints floats bools and strings
test_product_duplicate_keys: test that product raises a ValueError when two sweeps share the same parameter name
